name: Amagi Narumi
source:
Apple Polisher's vocalist. A vocal with clear singing voice.
Although he spent much time abroad, his speech is clear. He is also a straight personality and the youngest in the band. Narumi often writes lyrics for the songs apple-polisher.
Makes an appearence in Dynamic Chord feat. [rēve parfait] as Rio's childhood friend.
